gates.name: Components have no inline style block, I*State interface or DOCTYPE outside the app component, and attributes sit above members
gates.checks: It reads the `.razor` and `.cs` files under `paths.sourceRoot`. It fails on an `I*State` interface, an inline `<style>` block and a `<!DOCTYPE` outside the app component. It also fails on an attribute on the same line as its member. Exit 2 means `paths.sourceRoot` is not set or the old key `dotnet.portalAppComponent` is still set, and exit 3 means there is no file to read.
gates.fix: Use the state class, move each style to the `.razor.css` file, keep the DOCTYPE in the app component, and put each attribute above its member.
